# E0415: a lacuna on each has no when

A lacuna applies under the condition its mapping implies; an each implies
none, since it maps every element. A lacuna on an each says when it applies
with `when`.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	items: [...{
		title: string
	}]
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	items: [...{
		name: string
	}]
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		items: each(v0_0.items, {
			name: item.title
		})
	}
	lacunas: {
		items: [{
			type:    LossyFieldMapping
			message: "titles were renamed"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		items: each(v1_0.items, {
			title: item.name
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0415]: lacunas.items: a lacuna on each needs when: <condition>
  --> 1.0.thema:15:11
   |
15 |         items: [{
   |                 ^
   |
```
